subject: COMPUTE statement
notes: GR3's 'subject to ... 14.6.13.2' leg was DISCHARGED by kb/Work PB230 (CobolBool.Sending at both boolean sending-read channels, pinned by pb230_incompatible_boolean_sending). The last residue - a reference-modified operand with a RUN-TIME length counted at its inner item's FULL length (the deleted ConditionBinder.RefModLen fallback) - is closed by kb/Work PB589: the largest-ITEM width is carried at run time beside the value (CobolBoolSized; each item leaf CobolBool.Item, each literal CobolBool.Literal, CobolBool.ToItemWidth at the root), so B(1:N), B(K:) and a BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER whose argument-2 is a run-time value (a function-identifier references a temporary data item, 8.4.3.2.4 GR1) are each counted at the length of the value they actually produced. One renderer serves every site that states this width: COMPUTE Format 2 and the BY CONTENT boolean argument of CALL and INVOKE. Measured before/after on the same program: COMPUTE R8 = B8(1:N) B-OR B"1111111" with N=3 gave 11111110, now 11100000; B8(K:) with K=6 the same; BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER(3, W) B-OR B"0000001" with W=2 gave 11000010, now 11000000; CALL ... BY CONTENT B8(1:N) B-OR B"1111111" into a PIC 1 ANY LENGTH formal gave [11111110] LEN=8, now [111] LEN=3. The bit-group width model (PB157/PB173) is unchanged. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Procedure/Verbs/ConditionBinder.cs#Gr3Width (kb/Work PB589 deleted the bind-time Gr3Width: the GR3 width is a run-time quantity and is now carried beside the value by BooleanRenderer.RenderAtItemWidth / CobolBool.ToItemWidth)
